title: Prompt engineering
text: Clear instructions, constraints, and examples improve reliability. Prefer structured outputs for automation.

title: Embeddings
text: Embeddings represent text as vectors. Similar meaning results in nearby vectors; use cosine similarity for search.

title: RAG
text: Retrieval-augmented generation retrieves relevant chunks and injects them into the prompt to ground answers.

title: Chunking
text: Split documents into 600–1000 character chunks to improve retrieval precision and reduce irrelevant context.

title: Agents and tools
text: Agents can call tools like calculators or retrievers in a loop: decide → act → observe → answer.

title: Security
text: Never commit API keys. Use environment variables and keep secrets out of logs.
